records.summary_note: accounting_complete in the published summary means complete token usage (usage_complete in scripts/cmass_results.py); GPT cost is unknown.

changes_from_cmass_bm25.document_pool: Each search also adds its top-1,000 BM25 documents (k1=0.9, b=0.4, same index) with full text to a per-question pool.
changes_from_cmass_bm25.pool_grep_tool: System Two tool: RE2 co-occurrence over the pooled full text (all_of, show, near, window<=300, max_docs<=40, offset); at most 8,000 characters and 5 seconds per call; one added prompt rule.
changes_from_cmass_bm25.jev_find_return: The text shown to System Two omits documents without excerpts and internal trace fields; passages, coordinates, ranking and notices are unchanged.

runtime.config: configs/cmass-poolgrep.json = configs/cmass.json plus the pool settings and 4 workers
runtime.switch: scripts/run.py cmass --pool-grep sets CMASS_POOL_URL; without it the extension is the JevGPT-BM25 runtime
